Definition: Rimmon-Perets, a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: The name is Rimmon-Perets, a place in the Desert. You find the name in Numbers 33:19, "…they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmon-parez", and again in Numbers 33:20.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Rimmon-Perets counts, because the God of the Bible works in places you can find. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
